description: This file defines serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for the SortedSet<T> collection type within the Orleans framework, including codecs, surrogates, and deep copiers.

classes.name: SortedSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for SortedSet<T>, converting to and from a surrogate.

classes.name: SortedSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Data transfer object used as a surrogate for serializing SortedSet<T>.

classes.name: SortedSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for SortedSet<T> providing deep copy functionality.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back to a SortedSet<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a SortedSet<T> into its surrogate form.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a given SortedSet<T>.
